description:
Survival Tweaks
v1.0.0 for Starsector 0.98.5a
Download Here

Survival Tweaks is a config preset which adjusts survival mode settings to reflect my personal preferences. The goal is to make survival mode more closely resemble a slowed-down version of the base game by relaxing some of the more extreme changes which I feel distort the game's balance.

Main features:

Forced retirement happens after 40 cycles, up from 30, because John Starsector shouldn't have a lower mandatory retirement age than the average cop. Retirement becomes optional after 30 cycles, up from 25.
Domain-grade parts are more rare, forcing you to be more selective about which d-mods to remove in the early game.
The price discount for d-modded ships has been reduced to reflect the ease of removing d-mods with Domain-grade parts.
Combat and salvaging provide more recoverable ships, weapons, and commodities (although still well below vanilla values) to fix exploration and combat being significantly less profitable than smuggling and missions in survival mode.
Recruitable officers and administrators are slightly more common.

Base ship prices and fuel capacity/costs are not affected, as I think the default settings for those are fine. If you want to make further tweaks to suit your preferences, you can easily do so by editing this mod's settings file.

This mod should be safe to add or remove mid-save.

Compatibility:

Survival Tweaks only edits survival mode settings so it's very lightweight and should work with just about any other mod, although it will obviously conflict with any mod that edits the same configs.

AI use:

No artificial intelligence was used in the creation of this mod (praise Ludd!)
